- NCLB shows discrete cigar-shaped lesions (not continuous streaks)
- Gray leaf spot shows narrow rectangular vein-bounded lesions
- Stewart's wilt shows stunted young plants
- All other candidates ruled out (spots, pustules, circular lesions, viral mosaic/yellowing patterns)

The hallmark of Goss's wilt — long tan necrotic leaf streaks with potential bacterial exudate freckles — precisely matches the test image.
